lines.beaver: 안녕하세요. 후원 대상 기준을 여쭤봐도 될까요?
lines.beaver_en: Hello. May I ask about the criteria for sponsorship recipients?
lines.beaver_roman: annyeonghaseyo. huwon daesang gijuneul yeojjwobwado doelkkayo?
lines.learner: 네, 저는 희망 복지 재단의 후원 담당자입니다.
lines.en: Yes, I'm in charge of sponsorship at the Hope Welfare Foundation.
lines.roman: ne, jeoneun huimang bokji jaedanui huwon damdangjaimnida.

lines.learner: 형편이 어려운 이웃과 보육원 아이들을 주로 후원합니다.
lines.en: We mainly support struggling neighbors and children in childcare homes.
lines.roman: hyeongpyeoni eoryeoun iutgwa boyugwon aideureul juro huwonhamnida.

lines.beaver_en: Is there an income requirement too?
lines.learner: 네, 소득이 적은 가정에 한하여 후원하고 있습니다.
lines.en: Yes, we support only low-income families.
lines.roman: ne, sodeugi jeogeun gajeonge hanhayeo huwonhago itseumnida.

lines.beaver_en: Are elderly people who receive a pension eligible?
lines.learner: 연금이 적은 분에 한하여 대상이 됩니다.
lines.en: Only those with a small pension are eligible.
lines.roman: yeongeumi jeogeun bune hanhayeo daesangi doemnida.

lines.learner: 전국 어디서든 재해를 입은 분은 모두 지원합니다.
lines.en: We support all disaster victims anywhere in the country.
lines.roman: jeonguk eodiseodeun jaehaereul ibeun buneun modu jiwonhamnida.

lines.beaver_en: Where does the sponsorship money come from?
lines.en: It comes from citizens' donations and regular sponsorship.

lines.learner: 대학생과 지역 주민들이 함께 봉사하고 있습니다.
lines.en: College students and local residents volunteer together.
lines.roman: daehaksaenggwa jiyeok jumindeuri hamkke bongsahago itseumnida.

lines.learner: 자원봉사로 이웃과 화합하게 되어 만족도가 높습니다.
lines.en: They're very satisfied, as volunteering brings harmony with neighbors.
lines.roman: jawonbongsaro iutgwa hwahaphage doeeo manjokdoga nopseumnida.

lines.beaver_en: I see. What will matter most in welfare from now on?
lines.learner: 이제 복지는 사회의 중심이고, 협력이 중요합니다.
lines.en: Welfare is now central to society, and cooperation matters.
lines.roman: ije bokjineun sahoeui jungsimigo, hyeomnyeogi jungyohamnida.

lines.beaver_en: Thank you for your kind words. I learned a lot.
lines.learner: 이웃 사랑이 정말 중요하지요. 또 연락 주세요.
lines.en: Loving your neighbors really matters. Feel free to contact us again.
lines.roman: iut sarangi jeongmal jungyohajiyo. tto yeollak juseyo.
